title.value: Gradient descent for matrix factorization: Understanding large initialization

abstract.value: In deep learning practice, large random initialization is commonly used. Understanding the behavior of gradient descent (GD) with such initialization is both crucial and challenging. This paper focuses on a simplified matrix factorization problem, delving into the dynamics of GD when using large initialization. Leveraging a novel signal-to-noise ratio argument and an inductive argument, we offer a detailed trajectory analysis of GD from the initial point to the global minima. Our insights indicate that even with a large initialization, GD can exhibit incremental learning, which coincides with experimental observations.
